observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor street performance on a paved city street with onlookers watching from the sides.
observation.dancers: A large group of mixed female youth dancers in matching attire, accompanied by a few male leaders/musicians wearing turbans.
observation.formation_and_space: Initially formed in rows facing forward, later transitioning into a circle formation where dancers move in a procession and circle around.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward leans during deep steps and knee bends.
observation.footwork: Stepping, marching, and high knee lifts on the upbeat/downbeat synchronised with drum beats.
observation.arms_and_hands: Holding lezim (wooden instruments with jingles attached by chains) in both hands, striking them together and raising them above the head in rhythmic patterns.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bending forward from the waist and swaying the torso in coordination with leg movements and drum beats.
observation.partnering: None, group choreography without physical partner contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Varying levels from upright standing to low knee bends, high knee kicks, and occasional turning movements in circle formation.
observation.costume_and_props: Red long-sleeved tunics, white trousers, white shoes, white sashes around the waist, and hair tied back. Holding lezim instruments.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and weight distribution are partially obscured by long tunics and camera movements.

signature_moments.what: High knee raises while striking lezim instruments rhythmically overhead in a group circle.
Dancers bend deeply at the waist and swing lezim instruments down and up while stepping in a circle.
